finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Just a needy god,” Jake shrugged, getting a few weird stares. “But I do have to leave now. You already have my number if I’m on the planet, but if I’m in another universe, just contact Miranda or Caleb.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Fair enough. But just so you know, I don’t need an update about what the system notification said; I already heard it,” the Viper quickly clarified, getting a mental confirmation from Jake.
